name: zoho
description: Zoho connector for Global LMS CRM, Mail, Books, and Desk workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Global LMS to Zoho apps.
interface.longDescription: A config-driven Zoho connector for Global LMS that can create CRM leads, send Zoho Mail, create Books contacts and invoices, and open Desk tickets using Zoho OAuth refresh tokens.
defaultPrompt: Create a CRM lead from an LMS contact.
Send a Zoho Mail update to subscribers.
Open a Zoho Desk ticket from support requests.
